title: Smokey Dried Chicken Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and savory Chinese-inspired stir fry made with smoky and dried ingredients.

ingredients.name: dried vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as carrots and bell peppers

instructions: Heat the smoke oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the wok and set aside.
Add the curry paste to the wok and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the dried vegetables and cook until they start to soften, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the citrus juice, ginger, and garlic to the wok and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the wok and stir to combine with the vegetables and sauce.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
Garnish with fresh herbs, such as cilantro or scallions, if desired.
